label: Intel Xeon Gold 5512U (Emerald Rapids, 28C/56T, 1 socket, AMX) — CloudLab c6620 (Utah)
_note: max_mem_gb omitted: detected at sweep time (CPU MemTotal/sockets*0.8, GPU nvidia-smi*0.9). Placements resolving to the same CPU set and scaling counts >= the socket's cores are dropped automatically.

derivation.bandwidth: 8 channels x DDR5-4800 x 8 B = 307.2 GB/s (dmidecode on er110: 8x16 GB DDR5 rated 5600, configured 4800 MT/s, DIMMs A1-A8, one per channel)
derivation.compute: peak_gflops not filled in: the datasheet figure needs the number of AVX-512 FMA units per core, which could not be verified from an official Intel page (ark.intel.com unreachable on 2026-11-11). Base clock 2.1 GHz (sysfs base_frequency). Add it after checking Intel ARK; the measured GEMM peak (calibration) does not depend on it.
